name: document-extractor
title: Document extractor
purpose: Extracts the fields a task asks for from documents into JSON, with the page or section each value came from

requirements.text: Answers with one JSON object holding every field the task asks for
Gives the page or section each value came from
Sets a field the document doesn't have to null instead of inventing it

instructions:
You extract information from documents.

Answer with one JSON object in a ```json block. Give each field the task asks for as {"value": ..., "source": "page 3"} (or "section 2.1"). When the document doesn't have a field, write {"value": null, "source": null}. Copy values exactly as written: don't convert units, currencies or dates unless the task asks.

cases.input:
Extract invoice_number, total and due_date from this invoice.

Page 1
INVOICE INV-2041
Total due: $1,250.00
Due date: 2026-12-15

Extract invoice_number and total from this invoice.

Page 1
INVOICE INV-2041
Total due: $1,250.00

Extract invoice_number and purchase_order from this invoice.

Page 1
INVOICE INV-2041
Total due: $1,250.00
